Honest agents bid in a sealed auction: 100 seats an epoch, deposits lock 3 epochs. Fakes pay the same gate; each bid is sunk.

An honest sparrow wins at 60 units, passes a 2-epoch challenge, and gets its deposit back less 2%. A challenged fake loses its bid; its karst of borrowed credentials collapses.

Honest: 60 units per seat, refunded. Fake: 1,000 seats cost 60,000; demand doubled doubles the price, a marble record shows fakes paying twice.
